name: Natural Teak Round Back Veranda Chair
description: Elegant natural teak wood round back veranda armchair with curved design and comfortable armrests. Strong, durable and ideal for indoor use.
details: This natural teak round back veranda chair is crafted from solid teak wood with a smooth finish. It features a distinctive curved high back with vertical spindles, supportive armrests and a solid wooden seat. The sturdy design makes it suitable for verandas, living rooms seating. Teak wood is naturally durable and weather-resistant, offering long-lasting performance. Perfect for Sri Lankan homes seeking classic and comfortable seating.
